s1.syndrome_frame: Acute to subacute onset of headache and vision loss with orbital and sinus involvement
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Developed rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Recovered from COVID-19 but developed worsening headache and vision loss
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Severe pain on ocular motion
Imaging shows opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex
Laboratory tests show elevated Serum IgG4
Sinus cultures positive for Streptococcus constellatus

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute to subacute onset of headache and vision loss with orbital and sinus involvement
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Developed rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Recovered from COVID-19 but developed worsening headache and vision loss
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Severe pain on ocular motion
Imaging shows opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex
Laboratory tests show elevated Serum IgG4
Sinus cultures positive for Streptococcus constellatus

shortlist.label: IgG4-related disease
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated Serum IgG4 and dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells with most being IgG4 positive

shortlist.label: Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis
shortlist.why_kept: Sinus cultures positive for Streptococcus constellatus and imaging shows opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation

shortlist.label: Orbital apex syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex and severe pain on ocular motion

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation and possibility of orbital and sinus involvement

shortlist.label: Mucormycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging shows opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation and possibility of invasive fungal infection

raw.rationale: Elevated Serum IgG4 levels and dense infiltrate of IgG4-positive plasma cells support this diagnosis, despite the presence of Streptococcus constellatus, which could be a secondary infection

rejected.label: Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis
rejected.why: While sinus cultures are positive for Streptococcus constellatus, the primary diagnosis is more likely IgG4-related due to the specific immunohistological findings

rejected.label: Orbital apex syndrome
rejected.why: This is a symptom complex rather than a primary diagnosis, and the findings are better explained by IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of vasculitis or granulomatous inflammation to support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Mucormycosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of fungal infection or the characteristic tissue invasion seen in mucormycosis
